html: † שָׁעָה n.f. brief time, moment (𝔗 id., שָֽׁעֲתָא, NH שָׁעָה time, hour; Syriac ܫܳܥܬܳܐ moment, then hour Brock 369, but Chr-Pal. ܫܥܳܐ moment, hour SchwallyIdiot. 97 SchulthLex. 211; perhaps = Assyrian šattu, duration; TelAm.91, 77 še-ti, time, hour (as Canaanism) WklKAT3. 335; Arabic سِعْوٌ, سَاعَةٌ portion of time, Ethiopic ሳዕ time, ሰዓት hour, time (Buhl calls Arabic Ethiopic loan-words, but v. Wkll.c.); √ unknown: poss. Assyrian loan-word (v. Wkll.c.); DlPr 39 f. conj. שׁיע = שָׁעָה look, hence moment = ‘Augenblick,’ but vb. שׁ׳ rather of steady gaze);—moment: usually emph. בַּהּ־שַׁעֲתָא (read poss. שָֽׁ׳ as 𝔗 Syriac, M86* f. Buhl14 cf. var. in Str) in the same moment, forthwith Dn 3:6, 15; 4:30; 5:5; abs. שָׁעָה חֲדָה 4:16 for a moment.
